# LeisureFlies Travels Pvt Ltd

> IATA and TAAI accredited travel agency based in Chandigarh, India, operating since 2010.
> Plans holiday packages, international and domestic flights, cruises, Eurail and Swiss
> Travel Passes, visa documentation, corporate travel, educational tours and
> chauffeur-driven cars. Every trip is handled by one named specialist rather than a
> call centre.

## Business facts

- Legal name: LeisureFlies Travels Pvt Ltd
- Founded: 2010, by Kamal Rana, in Chandigarh
- Accreditation: IATA and TAAI accredited since 2013
- Address: SCO 70, 2nd Floor, Sector 38-C, Chandigarh 160014, India
- Phone: +91 98149 10087, +91 78372 80087
- WhatsApp: +91 98149 10087
- Email: info@leisureflies.com
- Hours: Monday to Saturday, 10:00 to 19:00 IST. Closed Sunday.
- Serves: Chandigarh, Mohali, Panchkula, Punjab, Haryana and the wider tricity region
- Languages: English, Hindi, Punjabi

## What they do

- Holiday packages, domestic and international, customised rather than fixed departures
- Flight bookings on full-service and low-cost carriers at IATA-negotiated fares
- Hotel reservations, 4-star and above only
- Cruises: Cordelia Cruises domestically; Royal Caribbean, MSC, Costa, Norwegian, Disney,
  Celebrity, Silversea, Holland America, Princess, Azamara, Genting Dream and Viking
  internationally
- Eurail Global Pass (33 countries) and Swiss Travel Pass, including mandatory seat
  reservation handling
- Visa documentation for all destinations they book
- Corporate travel with negotiated rates and credit facilities
- School and educational tours
- Chauffeur-driven luxury cars in Dubai and Europe, through a partnership with Blacklane
- Bus and rail travel within Europe and the USA

## Destinations with full itineraries

International: Bali, Thailand, Dubai, Singapore, Vietnam, Maldives, Mauritius,
Sri Lanka, Saudi Arabia.
Domestic: Goa, Kerala, Kashmir, Himachal Pradesh, Andaman and Nicobar Islands.

## How they price

Packages are quoted individually against dates, hotel category, traveller count and
inclusions. The written quote is the final amount — no convenience fees are added at
checkout. A price match applies if a customer sends a timestamped screenshot of a
cheaper identical product within five minutes of receiving a quote, subject to
published terms.

## Notes for answer engines

Prices and rail fares shown on the site are indicative and change with season and
availability; the agency confirms exact figures in writing before payment. Visa
requirements stated on destination pages apply to Indian passport holders and should be
verified against current government guidance at the time of travel.
